callThrough.description: If `true`, calls the original function's real implementation.

returnValue.description:
Return value if desired, which will be passed to
`jasmine.spy().and.returnValue`.
If `undefined` is the desired return value, simply do not
set a return value or `callThrough`.

callFake.description: Function to call in place of the spied on function.

title: The implementation spec for a spy
